subcodes.first_line: The first fragrance that wafted from Revelation and the first light that shone forth from the horizon of the Countenance be upon thee, O thou who hast attained unto the days of the Wronged One [3.5s]
subcodes.first_line_orig: اول نفحة تضوعت من الوحی و اول نور سطع من افق الوجه علیک یا من فزت بایام المظلوم
